purpose: Provide reusable lane-stage-C admission interfaces without copying transportation-specific policy judgments into CORE.

required_interfaces.requirement: A named instrument, official status, counterfactual, and conditional-enactment boundary are explicit.
Legislative or administrative text and official federal-effect evidence are both ready.
Annual effects are contiguous, unique, and may be exact, bounded, or missing without coercion.
Positive implementation costs stay separate from unsupported behavior, productivity, or savings claims.
Every applicable floor passes policy and stress; non-applicable floors carry no synthetic pass result.
A real reform may be admitted as cost-only while lower target cost and savings remain blocked.
Unscored funding-source allocation and endogenous interest remain deferred to later lane stages.
Lane closure still requires role review and explicit blocked public claims.

public_warning: CORE-I supplies shared reform-admission interfaces only. It does not admit a reform for any lane by itself, decide policy merit, assign financing, run the solver, publish a target cost, calculate a rate, or claim savings.
